text.en: The Camp Ofelia Elementary School in Barangay Lintangan, Municipality of Sibuco, Province of Zamboanga del Norte is hereby converted into an integrated school to be known as Lintangan Integrated School.
All personnel, assets, Liabilities, and records of the Camp Ofelia Elementary School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Lintangan Integrated School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Lintangan Integrated School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
